// diagnostic E0646

Jet.ImportPointsUpALayer

`{from}` in layer `{from_layer}` cannot import `{to}` in higher layer `{to_layer}`

What

`{from}` in layer `{from_layer}` cannot import `{to}` in higher layer `{to_layer}`

Why

The package's `layers:` table orders layers lowest first, and imports may only point to the same layer or a lower one

Fix

Move the code that imports `{to}` up to layer `{to_layer}`, move what it needs down to `{from_layer}` or lower, or invert the dependency through a trait in `{from_layer}`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ImportPointsUpALayer: Tests/UI/import_points_up_a_layer/stderr.

Error: Jet.ImportPointsUpALayer: `app.storage` in layer `storage` cannot import `app.ui` in higher layer `ui`
  --> storage.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | use ui
    | ^^^^^^
 Why: The package's `layers:` table orders layers lowest first, and imports may only point to the same layer or a lower one
 Fix: Move the code that imports `app.ui` up to layer `ui`, move what it needs down to `storage` or lower, or invert the dependency through a trait in `storage`
